nested_dependency_rule: For outer test fold f, test local reference uses folds != f. Every familywise-reference attempt in inner fold g is itself scored using only folds != f and != g. Thus no feature from outer test fold f can affect either its local score or the familywise reference scores against which it is compared.
future_scoring_rule: For a fresh attempt, score against the full sealed historical local reference, then compute add-one upper-tail probability against the sealed cross-fitted historical attempt-statistic reference at the highest supported multiplicity-conditioning level.
